newsitem.title: FRANCE: Spanish crown prince ends visit to France.
newsitem.headline: Spanish crown prince ends visit to France.

text.p: Crown Prince Felipe of Spain, a licensed pilot, wound up a four-day visit to France on Thursday with a tour of the Airbus passenger aircraft assembly chain in Toulouse.
The prince, who met the Spanish community in this southwestern city late on Wednesday, visited the Aerospatiale factory before flying home.

The 28-year-old prince, on his first official visit to a major power, was accompanied by Spanish Foreign Minister Abel Matutes. He met President Jacques Chirac and Prime Minister Alain Juppe in Paris earlier in the week to discuss European and other international issues.
